card.statement:
[proved in Section <<ref:sskw>>]

- [(a)] The following three conditions are equivalent for a finite poset $\mathcal P$:

- [(i)] $\mathcal P$ is unitarily representation-finite,

- [(ii)] $\mathcal P$ is a chain,

- [(iii)] the form $u_{\mathcal P}$ is positive definite.

- [(b)] The following three conditions are equivalent for a finite poset $\mathcal P$:

- [(i)] $\mathcal P$ is unitarily tame,

- [(ii)] $\mathcal P$ is a semichain,

- [(iii)] the form $u_{\mathcal P}$ is nonnegative definite.
card.label: Theorem 1

paper.title: Systems of subspaces of a unitary space
paper.abstract: For a given poset, we consider its representations by systems of subspaces of a unitary space ordered by inclusion. We classify such systems for all posets for which an explicit classification is possible.
